templates.name: Developer desk
templates.description: Hacker News down the middle; the time, Claude and ChatGPT quota and the machine on the left; service checks, the network and releases of your tools on the right. A second page for focus: a 50/10 timer, a scratchpad, links, tasks and the week.

templates.name: Morning news
templates.description: A front page on the light Paper skin: lead stories from five papers down the middle; the time, the weather and the lunar date on the left; gold, the world and the dollar on the right. A second page has business, tech and sport.

templates.name: Morning overview
templates.description: What the day holds over the first coffee, on the light Grove skin: today's weather above the morning news, the time, the lunar date and today's tasks on one side, the air, gold and the dollar on the other.

templates.name: Market watch
templates.description: The four Vietnamese indices as one band of charts across the top, with blue chips, market news and gold under it. A second page has world indices, crypto, commodities, big tech and the exchanges' clocks.

templates.name: Study desk
templates.description: An English word card above your notes in the middle, a pomodoro with a daily goal and homework on the left, the time, the weather and the lunar calendar on the right, in the soft Mochi skin.

templates.name: Home lab
templates.description: Uptime checks above new releases of self-hosted apps in the middle, the clock, the network, CPU and disks on the left, a maintenance list and a runbook on the right, on the green Phosphor terminal skin.

templates.name: Night chill
templates.description: The end of the day on the Lo-fi Café skin, laid out as a mirror: a clock face above your journal, tomorrow's weather and list, a word to sleep on and the month. No news, no prices.

templates.name: Minimal desk
templates.description: An analog clock, the weather, today's lunar date and a to-do list pinned to the desktop, without headers. Nothing else.

widgets.name: Tech news
widgets.description: Hacker News front page and The Verge in one list.

widgets.name: Tin Việt Nam
widgets.description: VnExpress, Tuổi Trẻ, Thanh Niên and Dân Trí as a grid of cards.

widgets.name: Kinh tế & chứng khoán
widgets.description: Stock market news from CafeF, VnEconomy and Vietstock.

widgets.name: Developer blogs
widgets.description: The GitHub blog, Show HN and Viblo as compact headlines.

widgets.name: Show HN
widgets.description: What people are building, straight from Hacker News.

widgets.name: AI tool releases
widgets.description: New versions of Claude Code, Ollama and llama.cpp, marked until you open them.

widgets.name: World clock
widgets.description: Tokyo, London and New York with their offset from you.

widgets.name: Weather in Saigon
widgets.description: Now, the next 12 hours and 7 days for Ho Chi Minh City.

widgets.name: Crypto
widgets.description: Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana with a price chart.

widgets.name: Ngày lễ Việt Nam
widgets.description: A calendar counting down to the public holidays.

widgets.name: Deep work timer
widgets.description: 50 minutes of focus, 10 of rest. Needs the Pomodoro source.
